newsitem.title: CHINA: PRESS DIGEST - Chinese newspapers - Oct 31.
newsitem.headline: PRESS DIGEST - Chinese newspapers - Oct 31.

text.p: Following is a summary of major Chinese political and business stories in leading newspapers, prepared by Reuters in Beijing. Reuters has not checked the stories and does not guarantee their accuracy. Telephone: (8610) 6532-1921. Fax: (8610) 6532-4978.
China celebrates the 50th anniversary of a campaign to harness the Yellow River.
Deng Xiaoping's works on building socialist spiritual civilisation are a scientific guide to work in political thought in the modern age, newspaper says
A commentary says Western journalists do not know what is really going on China and urges reporters to be accurate, objective and fair in their coverage of China.
China's broad M2 money supply rises by a year-on-year 26.8 percent at the end of the third quarter to 7.2042 trillion yuan.
China's foreign exchange reserves reached $95.363 billion at the end of September.
China's gold reserves were 12.67 million ounces at the end of September.
The State Economic and Trade Commission forecasts China's gross domestic product in 1996 will rise a year-on-year 9.8 percent to hit 6.91 trillion yuan.
The Ministry of Finance is drawing up new measures on bonds reform.
